Name: (AT) Pet Bowl - Pets need to eat as well
Author: MintTeax21
Description:
Hello! 

This mod is a retexture mod using an Alternative Texture mod for the pet bowls.

Have you ever wondered why we cannot feed our cats and dogs?
We feed cows and chickens,
so why not our pets??


This is a tweaked version of 1.6 pet bowls to suit my taste better.
The things that changed are:

1. Add more color variances.
2. Remove the tiles below the bowl. - I love that there are more options in 1.6, but sadly they don't really fit my farm.
3. Add a food bowl.





﻿[img]http://imgur.com/d7koMdW.png[/img]

I used an asset from [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2671?tab=description]Taelende's PetHouse[/url] - an adorable mod which is sadly not been maintained since 2018. 
I tweaked and colorized the pet bowl textures, but the original credit goes to Taelende :)
